Product Information: Material: Polyester & Polyester Blend Construction: With 3 Inches Rod Pocket on Top Optional Sizes: 54x18inch（137x45cm） Package Included: 1 Exquisite Curtain Panel Main Features: Meticulously crafted, the thread ends are neatly cut. Add a beautiful and fashionable style to your windows. Provide absolute privacy, heat insulation and noise reduction. Protect floors, carpets and upholstery from fading caused by sunlight. Let the soft sunlight flow into the room gently to keep it comfortable. Care Instructions: Hand wash in cold water or machine wash, hand wash is advisable. Gentle cycle, no bleaching, air dry is better. If necessary, please iron at low temperature. Blackout Functions: The window curtains are crafted with triple woven blackout fabrics with a silky touch and a beautiful drape. They can block out 85%-95% sunlight and UV ray, perfect for light-sensitive sleepers, napping children, day sleepers and night shift workers. These window drapes can reduce noise from busy streets or noisy neighbors, and ensure utmost privacy, providing you a decent space to enjoy working, sleeping or gaming.

100% BLACKOUT: Double-layer lined blackout curtains. Makes the drapes durable and thick enough to completely keep out 100% sunlight and UV ray. Stops heat and chill from coming through your windows, enjoy a darken environment for sleeping or home theatre
MULTI FUNCTIONS: Sophisticated workmanship added on these rich window treament coverings. Material inter woven technology is determined these good sense drapes feature vinyl free and ECO- friendly, highlights on offering increased insulation against heat and cold for year-round use, energy saving, noise reducing and privacy protection
STYLISH DECOR: These full blackout decent curtains are crafted from faux silk satin on the face layer, showcase super thick, solid, soft, heavy hand feeling, luxurious and eye-catching, linded with excellent thermal fabric on backing, give your window a crisp, streamlined look with the contemporary design
EASY CARE: Hassle free for purchase H.VERSAILTEX blackout curtains. Machine washable in cold water, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low and cool iron on face side as needed

Grommet Top Design: RUTTERLLOW grommet blackout curtains have 6 shiny grommets, 1.6” inner diameter each, fit standard size curtains rod, look great when you hung on coordinating metal rod.
Functions: RUTTERLLOW blackout curtains can block out 80-95% sunlight due to different colors (Dark color works better than light color). As a barrier, our blackout curtains’ quality is heavy enough to insulate your home against outside thermal energy in summer. On the contrary, keeps outside cold away from your warm house. Also, our curtains can reduce the noise from outside to provide you a better environment to work or sleep.
More Choices: These heavy quality blackout curtains are available for multiple options in colors & sizes. Coordinate with our RUTTERLLOW linen sheer curtains in our store to provide you a delicate home décor experience.
Easy Care: Machine washable (in cold water) for easy care and maintenance. Do not bleach, tumble dry low and warm iron as needed.

Bohemian style: The curtains are matched with geometric arrow patterns, and the geometric printing patterns are arranged neatly to show the exquisite Bohemian style. The panel adopts unique decoration technology, and the edges are decorated with exquisite and interesting tassels. Add elegant style and popular elements to your room, which is very decorative.
Material and function: The curtain is made of high-grade cotton hemp blended fiber, which is comfortable and breathable. The panel is soft, antistatic, hypoallergenic, and healthy. It can block outdoor heat and reduce energy consumption. The translucent design can filter the dazzling sunlight and heat, and ensure the privacy of your friends and family at home.
Applicable scenario: Our curtains use Beige panels, which can filter the heat of the sun, but will not prevent the light from entering the room. The geometric pattern on the panel adds a soft appearance to your room and makes your room more comfortable. It is suitable for hanging in bedrooms, living rooms, restaurants, balconies, kitchens and other places. Make you feel happy and relaxed.
Packaging: Each package contains a bohemian curtain panel. The top rod bag matches the standard curtain rod, and the sewn rod bag is very easy to hang and slide.
Easy to clean: The curtains can be washed with a washing machine. Wash in low-temperature water with mild detergent. Iron if necessary. Dry in a well-ventilated place. Do not expose to the sun, twist or bleach.

READY MADE: Each package includes 2 pieces of semi sheer curtains in W 29" x L 45". So the total width is 58" and the length is measured from top to bottom of the curtain fabric. The bottom hem is about 0.4".
FUNCTION: Linen texture material can effectively block harsh light entering room while providing you with some privacy. The 3-inch rod pocket opening fits most curtain rods whose diameter is less than 1.8 inches.
NICE DECORATION: The elegant design provides a modern look while refreshing and brightening your space in a simple way through sheer curtains. They can be easily integrated into your kitchen, bathroom, laundry room, cafe, living room, studio or any place you want to use.
WASHING INSTRUCTION: Machine wash in cold water (below 86°F/30°C), gentle cycle, tumble drying. Do not bleach. Cool down the iron if necessary, for example, some wrinkles due to transportation.
WARM TIPS: Due to different screen display, the color of actual item may vary slightly from images. And there may be an error (1-2 cm) because of hand-cutting.

Ready Made: These linen curtains add a touch of nature to your windows. Each panel measures 52"W x 84"L from top to end, 2 panels included. Warm up your space with superlative qualities and breathable look and feel of JINCHAN curtains.
Rustic Look: With a solid, textured linen blend fabric, these curtains bring both casual freshness and country style to the room. While maintaining simple and generous sensibility, these 84 inches long curtains can match most style in your home.
Versatile Use: Letting in just the right light, these neutral look farmhouse curtains act as a light filter and provide privacy to the room. They work well for your bedroom and living room windows, and can also be used as room dividers or closet coverings.
Modern Grommets: These grommet ring top curtains feature 8 matte silver rings on each panel. 1.6-inch inner diameter allows for most window curtain rods to go through. These linen drapes take little time to install and are easy to open and close.
Easy Care: Our linen blend curtains are durable thanks to the sturdy fabric and top notch sewing quality. They are machine washable in cold water gentle circle and tumble dry in gentle setting, no bleach. Creases due to packing and shipping can be pressed by ironing or steaming.
